name: 095 — http is a builder
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for the whole of feature 095: hafen.http():request(url) built bare and dispatched by :send(), the completion handler as req:on("done", fn) rather than a positional callback, the result as an object with :ok() :status() :body() :header(name) :error(), and hafen.http() as the collection of this addon's live requests with req:url() and :method(). It declares http.get and a network block, so it can drive the whole round trip against one allowlisted host.
